cells.gaps: No source found shows the localisation rule has lifted, or that it leaves transfers with consent or standard clauses free of the authority's certificate.
cells.note: Rescored under Bill's ruling of 2026-10-31 (messages-for-bill 58): [RWA-001] and [RWA-003] answer question 1: article 49 of law 058/2021 sets the transfer rule. [RWA-006] says the law generally requires personal data to be stored in Rwanda unless the authority grants a certificate, which makes question 2 closed; [RWA-005] says there is no blanket requirement, and the stricter reading holds. The run stops at 2.
